{{Quote|You there: you must be those ''aruetiise'' Kad brought down. Slide on down and have a drink with old Teroch.|Teroch|<ref name="FLT" />}}
'''Teroch''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Tall and muscular, with considerable martial skills and little interest in [[Politics/Legends|politics]], Teroch chose to make his living as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], working for a variety of clients over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. He was a friendly man and a skilled [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]], who cared greatly for [[Clan Awaud/Legends|his clan]] and took part in their migration from Mandalore to the backwater world of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]], where they established a new settlement known as [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]]. Over the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], Teroch fought against the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] numerous times for several clients, and in [[Time/Legends|time]], he assumed the role of ''[[gogi]]'', a veteran Mandalorian instructor. When he wasn't working, Teroch patronized the [[Sheb Niktose]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] at Arumorut, where he drank [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']] and shared stories with the bar's other customers.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sure, we spent some time working security for the Separatists during the Clone Wars, even took some jobs with the Hutts. Anyway, a few years in the field makes a Mandalorian want to put down roots. Nam found this place, and we've been working from Arumorut ever since.|Teroch|<ref name="FLT" />}}
Teroch was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name="FLT" />—the Mandalorians' cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], located in region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>—in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior<ref name="FLT" /> to the [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|Great Clan Wars]].<ref name="TBHC" /> A member of [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]], Teroch trained in combat from childhood,<ref name="FLT" /> before undergoing his ''[[verd'goten]]''—the traditional Mandalorian rite of passage that marked the transition into adulthood—at the age of thirteen, after which he became a recognized adult in Mandalorian society.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> In [[Time/Legends|time]], Teroch elected to use his skills as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to earn a living as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and he became friends with the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of Clan Awaud, [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]]. When tensions on Mandalore between the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] sect and the radical [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] were on the rise, Chieftain Beroya decided to avoid the ideological schism and take his clan offworld; Teroch followed, moving around the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] as the Mandalorian's nomadic ancestors had.<ref name="FLT" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="FLT" /> a pan-galactic struggle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> Teroch and several other mercenaries from Clan Awaud worked security for the Confederacy, and later took jobs that were offered by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|end]] of the war, and after years of living on the move, Teroch and his clan felt the need to finally settle down and establish a permanent home for themselves. They traveled to the planet [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]] in the Outer Rim's [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sector]], and in the [[Conifer/Legends|forested]] northern foothills, founded a Mandalorian [[City/Legends|settlement]] they called [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]]. From Arumorut, Teroch and his peers contracted mercenary and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] work throughout the regions of surrounding [[Realspace/Legends|space]], along [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. Teroch found himself pitted against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] multiple times over the next two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] a large number of the Empire's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] while battling Imperial patrols for clients. He also took part in Arumorut's defense of an allied [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] village nearby, after it came under attack by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. The Mandalorians were ultimately successful in driving the Zygerrians from Vlemoth Port, but not before they managed to capture dozens of Talz from the [[Gnaaz tribe]] and Nam Beroya, who had been wounded in battle. With Beroya believed dead by the members of Clan Awaud, his [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] daughter [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera]] succeeded him as chieftain, with Teroch's full support.<ref name="FLT" />

As he grew older, Teroch eventually became a ''[[gogi]]'',<ref name="FLT" /> an aged veteran who served as an instructor for younger Mandalorian [[Scout/Legends|scouts]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Teroch could be found on occasion at the [[Sheb Niktose]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], located near the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] lake that sat close to Arumorut. It was at the Sheb Niktose that Teroch met a group of operatives from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], who had come to Arumorut in the hopes of recruiting the resident mercenaries in a battle against the Galactic Empire. Though Teroch had been in the midst of a mug of [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']] with another Mandalorian, when he caught sight of the newcomers he was quick to invite them over to the bar to talk, spending nearly an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] with the rebel operatives, discussing the history of the clan while doing several shots of ''[[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]]'' together. He was later present at the [[Clan Home|home]] of Chieftain Vera Beroya when the rebels came to negotiate for her assistance, and conferred with Beroya on the logistics of the mission they were presented with.<ref name="FLT" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What do you think of the Empire?''"<br />"''Don't much care about it one way or the other, myself, and I suspect they don't care much about us either. We've fought off Imperial patrols for clients before, though. Killed more than my share of stormtroopers.|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative and Teroch|<ref name="FLT" />}}
[[File:Teroch_mini_game.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Teroch piloting a Fang fighter]]
Teroch was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male with a tall, muscular frame and a dark [[Color/Legends|brown]] complexion. He had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black hair, with a thick beard that had grayed with age, and a number of scars. Teroch cared little for [[Politics/Legends|politics]]—whether they involved the localized disputes between Death Watch and the New Mandalorians, or more large-scale matters like the Galactic Empire's activities—preferring a more simple existence as an apolitical mercenary. Possessed of a friendly demeanor, Teroch liked to talk with others, and he enjoyed drinking ''ne'tra gal'' or ''tihaar'' when he wasn't working.<ref name="FLT" />

A traditional Mandalorian, Teroch was an adherent<ref name="FLT" /> of the ''[[Resol'nare]]'', the six tenets of Mandalorian culture.<ref name="TMPaC" /> He spoke the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], in addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], and wore a suit of personally-owned [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. Teroch cared for the members of Clan Awaud, as well as its chieftains, and as a ''gogi'',<ref name="FLT" /> the veteran warrior passed along his knowledge to younger Mandalorian soldiers under his tutelage.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teroch was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2016]] ''[[Protectorate Starfighter Expansion Pack]]'' for the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]''.<ref name="OldTeroch">{{FFGXW|set=Protectorate Starfighter Expansion Pack|cardname=Old Teroch}}</ref> Teroch later appeared in Fantasy Flight Games' [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], 2016. ''Friends Like These'' elaborated on Teroch's history and ties to Clan Awaud, in addition to providing a full-body illustration of the Mandalorian veteran.<ref name="FLT" />
